anneal_statement_forms.name: Static & Post-Monomorphization Well-Formedness (`StaticBodyWf`, `ConstsTotal`, `MonoConstsWf`, `FnContractWellFormed`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: L.wf prog (localCount > 0, blocks != [], LocalLayoutsAdmitted <= isizeMaxBytes, ConstSucceeds \/ ConstUnwinds)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: No (Compiles alone does not constrain L_tgt.wf)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_productive_compiles: Yes (via explicit conjunct L_src.wf s <-> L_tgt.wf t in ProductiveCompiles)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_resource_bsim: Yes, when paired with target frame-size check (checkIsaFits / required_stack_space <= maxStack)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Target layout bounds (evalTyByteSize <= isizeMaxBytes) and target instruction/register fit check

anneal_statement_forms.name: Library ADT Invariant Admissibility (`AdmissibleAdtInv`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: NoDupIds (adts.map id) /\ forall decl in adts, allFieldsPubSafe -> validAdtDecl defaultAdtInv inner -> adtInv decl.id inner
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: Yes (preserved along decodeQuery / decodeOut representation codec)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: BehaviorCodec must decode target byte layouts back to source MirVal via validAdtDecl

anneal_statement_forms.name: Miracle-Freedom / Law of the Excluded Miracle (`Language.ProductiveOn`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: forall q, pre q -> exists h : (L.sem prog q).defined, exists o, (L.sem prog q).val h o
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_forward_sim: Yes (forward simulation maps source runs to target runs)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: No (fails on miraculous target queries or empty target transition relations; see productiveCompiles_rejects_query_slack_miracle)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_productive_compiles: Yes (via explicit productivity preservation conjunct in ProductiveCompiles)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_resource_bsim: Yes (even if outcome is Resource_limit_hit, an outcome still exists)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Target machine step relation must be total/inhabited on all safe states

anneal_statement_forms.name: All-Prefix Baseline UB-Freedom (`wellFormedOn` / `(MirSem body s).defined` on `SafetyPre`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: initMirState s /\ argsMatchInv s /\ (isUnsafe -> safetyPre s) -> forall n tr out, ReachesPrefix step body n s tr out -> out.isSafe
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_forward_sim: No (unless target is deterministic and source is receptive)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: Yes (by definition of Partial preorder: h_src : defined -> exists h_tgt : defined)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_resource_bsim: Yes, provided target stack overflow either triggers a safe trap or is ruled out by a static stack bound
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Target semantics must classify hardware faults, unmapped memory accesses, and ABI clobbers as .failed/.stuck

anneal_statement_forms.name: Return-Value Validity & Compile-Time Guard Freedom (`SafetyPost`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: (forall tr r, out = .terminated tr (.normal r) -> r.value.valid adts adtInv r.state localCount retTy) /\ (out != .terminated tr .compileTimeError)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: Yes (every target return decodes via decodeOut to a valid source return)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_resource_bsim: Yes (partial correctness on normal return holds vacuously on early OOM/StackOverflow)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: PartialBehaviorCodec decodeOut must return none on invalid target bit patterns (e.g. bool bytenotin {0, 1})

anneal_statement_forms.name: Conditional Functional & Relational Postconditions (`ContractPost`, `EffectivePost`, `EnsuresEqArg`, `EnsuresAtomicLoad`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: SafetyPost s out /\ (fn.safetyPre s -> AllHold (fn.specs.map (denotePostSpec s out)))
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_resource_bsim: Partial (holds on normal return; if postcondition requires normal return, needs stack/heap bound)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Calling-convention lens (`FramedCodec`) must preserve caller-saved/callee-saved register and memory framing

anneal_statement_forms.name: Total Termination & Reactive Liveness (`EventualOut.terminated` / `¬ .diverges` / `.reacts`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: forall out, (MirSem body s).val h out -> exists tr v, out = .terminated tr (.normal v)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: Yes over EventualBehaviorOf (fails over step-indexed BehaviorOf under pi_stepZero truncation)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_resource_bsim: No unless paired with quantitative stack/heap bound (`resource_refinement_transfers_partial_safety_but_not_termination`)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Well-founded stuttering measure per pass (no infinite silent target stuttering) + static stack bound <= headroom

anneal_statement_forms.name: Spatial Memory Footprint & Callee-Saved Frame Preservation (`FootprintAt`, `FramedCodec`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: Writes restricted to owned allocations/stack frame; caller locals and private spills unchanged
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: Only if target memory injection / PartitionedFrameLayout separates public and private stack slots
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_productive_compiles: Yes when paired with PartitionedFrameLayout (`Stacking`) and trace-level access checks
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Trace-level memory access bounds (`memaccessInbounds` / `FootprintPolicy`), not merely final-state `MAYCHANGE` (`mayChange_alone_cannot_exclude_unauthorized_load`)

anneal_statement_forms.name: 2-Safety Constant-Time & Secret Erasure (`ConstantTimeOn`, `TargetCTAndScrubbed`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: forall q1 q2, pubEq q1 q2 -> leakEq out1 out2 /\ postExitSecretResidual == 0
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_productive_compiles: No (standard compiler passes introduce secret branches, delete dead scrubs, and spill secret registers)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Either CompCert-CT + Besson IFP lockstep leakage/scrub simulation OR consumer-bound target-byte CT certificate check + hardware DIT/DOITM

anneal_statement_forms.name: Crate-Level Obligation Envelope & Waiver Ledger (`VerificationResult`, `CrateTheorem`)
anneal_statement_forms.formal_shape: c.functions != [] /\ NoDupIds /\ AdmissibleAdtInv /\ AllHold FnContractWellFormed /\ VerificationResult c.tcbWaivedIds obligations
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_compiles_demonic: Transfers per-function obligations when combined with OpenModule.link and ProductiveCompiles
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_productive_compiles: Yes (`CrateTheorem_transfers_to_IsaLang` when `c.tcb` records any remaining backend waivers)
anneal_statement_forms.transfers_under_resource_bsim: Yes (with stack bound obligation added to CrateTheorem)
anneal_statement_forms.required_side_conditions: Target compilation must cover both release (`bodyId`) and debug (`debugBodyId`) profiles or bind the emitted object to the verified profile
